method_notes.pair_filter: Reject pairwise comparisons whose denominator distance is less than min_pair_distance; Lr uses next-state distance while Lf and empirical Lq use source-state distance. No percentile trimming.
method_notes.aggregation: Arithmetic mean over eligible pairwise ratios.
method_notes.Lf: Within each represented category/action, mu_hat is constant in s, so f_hat has Jacobian I and Lf=1 exactly. Lf1/Lf2 are compatibility aliases for the same pooled mean-map constant, not separate noisy estimates.

Lf_noise_treatment: Observed successor noise is excluded; f_hat(s,a)=s+mu_hat[c,a].
